subject: Number of Covariate Markers in CIM

messages.author: 619711526701eb2c
messages.subject: Number of Covariate Markers in CIM
parts:
Good day, please what is the optimum number of markers one can use as covariates in CIM? The default n.marcovar=3; when I used both 3 and 15, 15 gave better results than 3. In MQM, they specified up to 50 marker covariates. Is there a way to find the optimum number of covariate markers to use in CIM?

Thanks.

Marcus.
